created_prompt:
I am a maker of cooking videos and I have a large online following. I want to grow the numbers of people following me and make them to watch more of my videos by making my videos informative, fun, and engaging. I also want to publish a cookbook containing recipes from my cooking videos. I do not know yet how to publish that book, e.g. either via a publisher or by self publishing. I am working four days a week and have limited time and budget. 
Please create for me a detailed and concrete three-year plan about how to achieve my goals, i.e., increase the number of people watching my videos, making them engage more with my videos, and helping my to write a cook book and the best way to publish it, i.e., maximizing the number of people buying and using my cookbook.
